parsed.narrative: Initial authorization is requested for Wegovy for chronic weight management. The patient is 42 years old [Patient/GLP1-007], with a BMI of 32.5 on August 8, 2026 [Observation/GLP1-007-BMI-2026-08-08]. Since January, she has followed a reduced-calorie meal plan with food logging and regular gym exercise, with dietitian-led weight-management support [DocumentReference/GLP1-007-PCP-001] [DocumentReference/GLP1-007-NUTR-001] [DocumentReference/GLP1-007-PCP-002]. Despite reported adherence, weight decreased 2.5% from January to August and has plateaued for the past couple of months [DocumentReference/GLP1-007-PCP-003]. The plan is to start Wegovy with standard dose titration while continuing diet and exercise [DocumentReference/GLP1-007-PCP-003].
